poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE WORLD'S GRAND SPECTACLES ARE BUT DISTANT WHISPERS. ONLY THIS QUIET MOMENT MATTERS.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: LET THE VASTNESS OF DREAMS FADE TO SOFT LIGHT, RESTING IN YOUR NEARBY EMBRACE.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: JUST US AND THE GOLDEN HOUR'S SLOW BREATH
sonnetLines: The map of dreams can wait until the dawn,
Let distant tides wash over empty space;
For all the wonders that the world has drawn,
They cannot match this quiet, steady grace.
No grand adventure calls our wandering feet,
No painted city holds a sweeter sight;
Bathed in the soft surrender of the light.
The river runs where your warm spirit lies,
A perfect stillness settles on the air;
Beneath these quiet, shared and knowing skies,
A simple truth is found beyond compare.
Let time suspend its hurried, restless pace,
And hold this moment in a loving embrace.

lyrics.text: I could travel to Paris and see the city lights
Ride a boat in Venice, what a beautiful sight
I could journey afar to an ocean so blue
But nothing is as beautiful as you
I could climb up a hill and watch the sunrise
Wander until the stars fill up the skies
But none of that matters if you aren't there, too
I wanna be next to you
If you would like to spend some time
I'd like to spend it with you
A glass of red wine
Just you and I
On a lazy afternoon
They say that someday the romance will fade
And tomorrow will be just another day
But even if we don't do anything at all
I wanna be where you are
If you would like to spend some time
I'd like to spend it with you
A glass of red wine
Just you and I
